discovery_notes: Follow-up 2 of B013 (packets 213, 420). 30 standard searches, snippets only. passiondlp quarterly archives (Q1, Q3 2018) name each PTN trio plus a dated Refresh Lanyard pin: Jan Inside Out, Feb Coco, Mar BatB, Jul Lion King, Aug 101 Dalmatians. Disney Gazette names the six July Minis. dein-dlrp Apr/Jun/Oct body text gave per-pin OE detail. Holds from 420 retained (Fun Adventures, Ursula BTM, Bambi Flower, Pirates & Princesses). Marvel June per-pin text found (hold key in 420). Cherry Blossom Girl designs only on reseller.
